item.title: Launch a WhatsApp-First Store in Minutes with Kommercly
item.description: I built Kommercly to make launching online instant. Agencies take weeks. DIY tools burn time and money on themes, apps, and invoices. Meanwhile buyers are already asking “price?” on WhatsApp. Kommercly is a no-code WhatsApp store builder that turns your Google Sheet into a live store fast — built for no-code ecommerce and fast online store launches in Bangladesh and beyond.

item.title: Kommercly
item.description: Kommercly is a no-code WhatsApp store builder that turns a Google Sheet into a live store in minutes. Built for entrepreneurs in Bangladesh and beyond who want to start selling online without the complexity of traditional ecommerce platforms. Features include WhatsApp-first ordering, real-time inventory from Sheets, and 0% platform fees.
